name: @hackathon-nvidia/go2-nav2-dua
description: Nav2 of the DottorCane (dua_nav2: dottorcane.launch.py, namespace /dottorcane/dua_nav2), on the real Go2 and in the simulation (go2_sim.launch.py). No code: declared for AgenticROS, which sends the goals and cancels them on ros2_estop.

capabilities.description: Navigate to a pose in the map frame with the DUA Nav2 (global plan, obstacle avoidance, Nav2 speed limits). Used by ros2_navigate_to_pose and ros2_navigate_to_place.

implementation.launch: ros2 launch dua_nav2_bringup dottorcane.launch.py (dua_nav2 container; use_sim_time:=true in simulation)
